commit.merge_subject: merge: feat: encoded preview presents through the gpu window

description: Encoded clips now present on the SurfaceView through the preview session instead of reading each frame back into a bitmap (the badge reads GPU, not GPU+bmp). New: the preview session's YUV door (nativePreviewSessionRenderYuvParcel: chain, LUT, node chain with the highlights/shadows bridge, stats pack, crop and zebra like the MCRAW door), GpuPreviewSession.renderEncoded, EncodedSource.gpuInput/releaseGpuInput, EncodedPreviewSession wrappers, the editor's encoded GPU arm (the MCRAW arm now excludes encoded sessions) and encoded gates (probe only; the parity leg decodes an MCRAW fd, the encoded door's parity is the device suite's). A manual rotation stays on the bitmap path: the window did not fold it for an encoded frame (landscape frame as a thin strip in the rotated box on the device); OpenDRT and non-NV12/P010 layouts stay there too. Device, debug, 13 s playback, 3 runs each: Mi-Log 4K6
